title: Holy Prophet(PBUH)'s Family Tree
author: 68a5cde3e966307c47abbf24
chapter_outcomes: Study his descendants, including his children, grandchildren and the direct line recognised among Shi'a Muslims as Imams

Study his leading Companions, including the Ten Blessed Companions, his Scribes, the major characters who surrounded him in his ministry, the Emigrants and Helpers, and the four Rightly Guided Caliphs during his lifetime
Know the names of the main characters who lived with and near the Prophet (pbuh), and the significant facts of their lives
Explain the importance of their actions and experiences in the history and beliefs of Islam
